notes: annual_mean_ta = calendar-year (or, for Southern-Hemisphere sites, Jul-Jun season-year -- item 4) mean TA_F, kept for the table-only comparison (item 5). ta_pre_start_*/ta_pre_end_* = mean TA_F over the fixed 60 days ending the day before the SITE'S OWN MEAN start/end date (not that year's own date), evaluated within each year's timeline. ta_window_avg_* = average of ta_pre_start_* and ta_pre_end_* -- item 5's GSL temperature-sensitivity predictor (Figure 6a), replacing annual_mean_ta.
